items.title: core/story-recall.ts: build story profiles + structured similarity scoring (no FTS)
items.context: experience-layer-types.ts: StoryProfile {storyId,title,type,phase,priority,keywords[],fileKinds[],touchpoints[],riskSignals[],notableFindings[],notableDecisions[],outcome}. core/story-recall.ts: buildStoryProfile(storyMeta) + scoreSimilarity(a,b) using structured-field overlap (Jaccard over keyword/fileKind/touchpoint sets + type/phase match). Pure, deterministic; zero outward imports except experience-layer-types + node:.
items.userSees: Build clean; the smoke asserts scoreSimilarity ranks an overlapping profile above a disjoint one and is symmetric/deterministic.

happy.desc: buildStoryProfile(storyMeta) returns a StoryProfile with all expected fields populated (storyId, title, type, phase, priority, keywords[], fileKinds[], touchpoints[], riskSignals[], notableFindings[], notableDecisions[], outcome); WHY: proves the profile builder extracts structured data from story metadata
scoreSimilarity(profileA, profileB) where A and B share keywords+fileKinds+type returns a score > 0; WHY: proves overlapping profiles produce a positive similarity score

scoreSimilarity(overlapping, disjoint) > scoreSimilarity(overlapping, totallyDifferent); overlapping profile outranks disjoint; WHY: core ranking invariant — stories with shared structure must score higher

edge.desc: scoreSimilarity(a, b) === scoreSimilarity(b, a) for any two profiles; WHY: similarity must be symmetric — asymmetry would cause inconsistent ranking
scoreSimilarity called twice with identical inputs returns identical score; WHY: determinism — non-deterministic scoring would make ranking unstable

scoreSimilarity where profiles share only one field dimension (same type, zero keyword/fileKind overlap) returns low but non-zero score; WHY: multi-field ensures no single-keyword coincidence dominates
buildStoryProfile with empty/minimal storyMeta (no files, no findings, no decisions) returns valid StoryProfile with empty arrays, no crash; WHY: graceful degradation for stories with sparse metadata
scoreSimilarity(emptyProfile, emptyProfile) returns 0 not NaN/Infinity; WHY: Jaccard(empty,empty) edge case must not produce NaN

adversarial.desc: scoreSimilarity with profiles containing duplicate keywords ([auth,auth,auth]) produces same score as deduplicated version; WHY: duplicate injection should not inflate similarity
buildStoryProfile with storyMeta containing unexpected/extra fields does not crash and ignores them; WHY: forward-compatibility — future metadata fields must not break profile building

story-recall.ts import fence: module imports only experience-layer-types + node: builtins (non-vacuous mutation check); WHY: coupling guard — recall importing handler/gate modules violates isolation contract

items.title: recallSimilarStories over the existing story_list scan (reuse, no derived index)
items.context: core/story-recall.ts: recallSimilarStories(targetProfile, candidateProfiles, topN) returns ranked matches with match reasons. The handler feeds it profiles built from the StoryStore enumeration (the existing story_list scan) — NO FTS, NO new derived index. The recall path is read-only.
items.userSees: The smoke seeds several stories, builds profiles via the store enumeration, and asserts recall returns the most-similar story first, respects top-N, and writes nothing.

items.title: handlers/recall.ts CLI (recall --story / --query --top) + registration; read-only
items.context: handlers/recall.ts: `recall --story <id>` profiles that story and prints top-N similar prior stories with match reasons + notable findings/decisions/outcome; `recall --query "..."` builds an ad-hoc keyword profile. Reuses the store enumeration; read-only (no writes, no gate). Register via command-policy(readOnly)/config/registry/cli-engine (flat underscore: recall).
items.userSees: `recall --story <id>` prints a ranked top-N list with match reasons; `recall --query "worker schedule"` returns keyword-matched stories; no files are written.

items.title: Smoke + npm script + no regression
